assets.prompt: Use case: game sprite asset, pose-controlled animation. Image1 is an EXACT 4-row x8-column pose guide: follow its two separately colored legs and the corresponding hand/knee/foot positions in EACH CELL. Dress EACH of those 32 guide figures as Mira from Image2, replacing the guide colors with Mira's navy/cream/gold outfit and silver hair. Image2 is ONLY identity, NEVER copy its stance or overlapping boots. Preserve Image1's WIDE TWO-LEG STANCE and TWO DISTINCT BOOT LANES in front/back. The left/right legs exchange lifted/planted roles in the second half of every row. The same image1 knees/ankles/arms MUST remain distinguishable after dressing. Short cream tunic ends above knees, short navy coat, fitted leggings, brown ankle boots separated horizontally; cloak and hair must NOT hide knees/boots. Keep the beautiful original detailed pixel-art face, silver hair and navy bow/gold brooch, blue-orb staff held low. 8-phase seamless WALK. Row1 front, row2 left, row3 right, row4 back. Make hair/cape lag the gait. Each full character centered in original guide cell with ample padding, all cell foot baselines stable. Chibi HD-2D crisp pixel clusters and the identity palette, two arms/two legs exactly. Output just the 32 whole-body sprites, transparent alpha background, no diagram colors, no background, no outlines around cells, no text. 2048x1024 landscape sheet. Explicitly show both left and right boots at all times instead of one centered boot.

Use case: game sprite asset, pose-controlled animation. Image1 is an EXACT four-row x eight-column MOTION GUIDE: redraw ALL 32 poses as a detailed fantasy pixel character. Keep the guide's knee/ankle/hand positions and left/right leg alternation cell by cell. Image2 is ONLY character identity/colors/clothes, NOT the stance. REPLACE its leg poses with Image1's. In front/back, keep the guide's two WIDE SEPARATE FOOT LANES and visible trousers below a short knee-high hem. Each cell two legs/two boots/two arms, never a third leg, never a merged central boot. Do not use one standing stance for all columns. Rows: SOUTH front, WEST side-left, EAST side-right, NORTH back. Columns1 and5 are OPPOSITE leg contacts, columns3 and7 have OPPOSITE lifted knees. Complete seamless8frames. Arms counter-swing opposite legs, shoulders/hips counterrotate, cloth and hair lag one frame behind. Keep body identity/scale stable, horizontal bodyroot in cellcenter, feet on consistent ground baseline with liftoff. Match the detailed HD-2D pixel clusters and palette of Image2, restrained highlights. Make shin/knee sections long enough to read alternating motion. Ample gutters and full figure in each cell. Transparent alpha background, no shadow/scenery/text/diagramcolors/grids, exactly32 complete figures. Landscape 2048x1024.
CHARACTER/ACTION: Mira, long silver hair and navy bow, navy/gold short coat above knees, short cream tunic, visible fitted leggings and TWO brown boots, blue-orb staff. RUN with forward lean, strong changing knee lift and stride. Hair/cape stream behind; free arm pumps.

Use case: game environment texture asset. Original cohesive high-quality HD-2D pixel-art material atlas for a cinematic miniature river valley RPG, rich natural textures with small irregular pixel clusters. FOUR EQUAL SQUARE MATERIAL TILES arranged exact 2columns x2rows filling a 2048x2048 image, NO gutters/borders/text. Top-left: lush realistic short meadow grass and tiny clover, varied deep moss/olive/emerald/sage greens, small straw tips, a few little leaves, organic patchiness, NOT neon, no tall grass or large flowers. Top-right: old irregular pale gray-beige limestone cobbled path with worn rounded angular stones, dark recessed joints, restrained tiny moss seams, different stone sizes, not a regular grid or bricks. Bottom-left: compact brown earth path, subtle fine gravel, tiny pebbles and roots, natural cool umber/ochre, organic worn soil, no grass clumps. Bottom-right: weathered riverbank limestone rock with irregular rounded cobble faces and moss between crevices, coherent with top-right material but larger rugged stones, layered mineral detail. All orthographic straight-on flat material swatches, consistent neutral soft illumination NO directional baked highlights/shadows and no perspective, so real 3D lighting can shade them. Each quadrant independently seamless edge-to-edge tileable. Crisp tasteful pixel-art surface, physically convincing small-scale detail. No characters, buildings, objects or water.
